## Context
Story: b6c0-1720-ead0-4da0 — .debug-active marker is a normative shared schema readable by the check-session-merge-only hook (S2) and the PreToolUse hook (S10)

## Goal
Create plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/docs/debug-active-marker-schema.md as the normative schema definition for the .debug-active marker.

## Testing Mode: NEW (no RED marker — doc-only file creation)

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/docs/debug-active-marker-schema.md | create | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Create directory: plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/docs/ (if it doesn't exist)
2. Create plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/docs/debug-active-marker-schema.md with:
   - Title: '# .debug-active Marker Schema'
   - Purpose section: explains the marker is created by Phase B Step 1 (ci-pr mode), read by check-session-merge-only.sh (S2), and read by the PreToolUse hook (S10 — future consumer)
   - Schema section:
     * File location: $REPO_ROOT/.debug-active (gitignored)
     * Format: text file, one key=value per line
     * Fields:
       - debug-session-id: \<UTC-timestamp>-\<6-char-random> (e.g., 20260512-141045-a3f9c2); UTC-timestamp format: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS
       - schema_version: 1
   - Stale detection rules:
     * A marker is STALE when: (a) the embedded timestamp in debug-session-id is older than TTL (default 24h, configurable via debug.session_ttl_hours config key), OR (b) no live process matches the session (implementation note: Phase A entry uses timestamp-only check for simplicity)
   - Pre-upgrade pattern:
     * Markers without schema_version field (or schema_version < 1) are pre-upgrade in-flight sessions; Phase A must refuse ci-pr operations and instruct the user to restart explicitly
   - Lifecycle section:
     * Created by: Phase B Step 1 when merge.strategy=pr
     * Removed by: Phase K before shutdown
     * Stale cleanup: Phase A entry before GHA pre-scan
   - Consumers section:
     * check-session-merge-only.sh: reads presence of .debug-active file only (does NOT parse fields)
     * S10 PreToolUse hook: reads debug-session-id field for session correlation

## Acceptance Criteria
- File exists at plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/docs/debug-active-marker-schema.md
- File contains 'debug-session-id' field definition
- File contains 'schema_version' field definition
- File contains lifecycle section referencing Phase B Step 1 creation and Phase K removal
- File is non-empty (> 0 bytes)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
